verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO certifications, the claim that data stays on monday's servers, and admin audit/credit tracking are adjacent privacy and security controls, not a user opt-out from tracking.
